current.routeCommand:
local q=_G.GrabItCloudE2E; assert(q and q.state and q.state.stage==1 and q.state.coins==0)
local root=game.ReplicatedStorage.GrabIt
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local items=require(root.Shared.Catalog).items(1)
local function await(check,seconds,message)
 local deadline=os.clock()+seconds
 repeat if check() then return end; task.wait(.1) until os.clock()>=deadline
 error(message)
end
local function walk(x,z)
 local character=assert(player.Character); local center=assert(character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')); local h=assert(character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'))
 local deadline=os.clock()+20
 repeat
  if (Vector3.new(x,center.Position.Y,z)-center.Position).Magnitude<2 then return end
  h:MoveTo(Vector3.new(x,center.Position.Y,z));task.wait(.15)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
 error('walking timed out')
end
q.started=os.clock()
task.spawn(function()
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  for _,trip in {{25,27},{26,28},{29,30},{19,21,7},{20,22,8},{1,3,2}} do
   local expected=q.state.coins
   walk(0,6)
   for n,id in trip do
    assert(q.state.stage==1 and q.state.open,'route exceeded real stage time')
    local item=items[id];walk(item.x,item.z);task.wait(.25)
    await(function() return q.state.target==id end,3,'wrong collection target')
    root.Action:FireServer('collect',id)
    await(function() return q.state.cargoCount==n end,4,'collection rejected')
    expected+=item.value
   end
   walk(0,6);walk(0,-8)
   await(function() return q.state.coins==expected and q.state.cargoCount==0 end,5,'deposit not confirmed')
   table.insert(q.trips,{items=trip,coins=q.state.coins,remaining=q.state.remaining,elapsed=os.clock()-q.started,save=q.state.save})
  end
  assert(q.state.coins==100,'must earn exactly 100 without grants')
  await(function() return q.state.save=='Saved' end,15,'earned coins not saved')
  q.earned100=true
 end)
 q.routePassed=ok;q.error=if ok then nil else tostring(err);q.finished=true
end)
return {started=true,remaining=q.state.remaining,route='normal walking and game collect remote; no synthetic coins'}
